content:
caleb_elmshore: Hey team — Elmshore here. We want to onboard a custom 13B summarizer for transaction and support logs. Need it in Private (VPC) with customer-managed KMS/HSM, strict PII redaction rules, and a safety-eval before go-live. Target: low latency for summaries (<300ms p50) and rollout in ~6 weeks. Who should I loop in?
maria_cs: Thanks @caleb_elmshore — that timeline is doable. Can you share the model artifact format and a small eval corpus? Also flagging renewal timeline: your annual committed capacity renewal is in ~8 weeks, so we should surface any Dedicated needs early. :calendar:
sam_eng: Quick Qs — is the model already quantized/gguf? If not, do you need us to recommend quantization/instance types. Example config we usually start from:
```
model: elm-13b-summarizer-2026
format: gguf or hf
quant: int8
autoscale: disabled (private)
latency_slo: 300ms
cache_prefix_kv: enabled
```
If you can paste the artifact name I can map memory/GPU requirements.
caleb_elmshore: Artifact is private-registry/elmshore/elm-13b-sum:v1 (HF). Not quantized. We'll need KMS + HSM for key wrapping, and data residency in eu-west-1.
rachel_security: Flagging security constraints: PHI/PII redaction is mandatory. We need to confirm retention policy, access controls, and send an ISV questionnaire. Also require audit logs for all inference requests and key rotation window. I'll prepare the checklist. :lock:
devon_ml: For safety/evals I propose: 1) hallucination rate (contradiction to gold) 2) PII leakage score (regex + redaction recall) 3) Factuality on core entities. We can run a 2k-sample eval set and baseline against open-13b. Acceptable thresholds: hallucination <3%, PII recall >95%. I can provide the harness — need seed prompts and representative logs.
maria_cs: I'll set up an enablement session for your infra/ops and product teams — 1hr slack call + 2hr walkthrough. When's good next week? Also want to discuss renewal structure: if you opt for Dedicated GPU pool we can propose a committed package that lowers unit cost — might be worth for predictable traffic.
caleb_elmshore: Next Thu afternoon works for enablement. About Dedicated — likely yes if we hit production traffic. Can you send a ballpark committed rate before the call? Finance will need it for renewal discussion.
sam_eng: Ballpark for a 4xA10 pool + 2xburst (EU region) — estimate monthly committed $18k–$25k depending on autoscale. I'll refine after model size/sequence-length numbers.
cs-bot: Checklist created: [ ] model artifact received (caleb_elmshore) [ ] eval corpus uploaded (caleb_elmshore) [ ] security questionnaire (rachel_security) [ ] infra sizing (sam_eng) [ ] enablement session scheduled (maria_cs) [ ] Dedicated pricing draft (sam_eng) [ ] safety-eval run (devon_ml)
maria_cs: Added action owners — I'll DM calendar invites. @rachel_security can you send the ISV/questionnaire link to @caleb_elmshore?
rachel_security: Sending now — please respond inline in the doc. Also confirm whether any raw PHI will be included in eval corpus; if yes we need a signed DPA addendum before transfer.
caleb_elmshore: No raw PHI in eval set, we'll sanitize before upload. We'll aim to deliver eval corpus by EOD Tue. Thanks — excited to get this moving :rocket:
devon_ml: Great — once we have the corpus I'll run the 2k baseline and post a short report (metrics + failure cases). Planning to include a small prompt-suite for regression gating.
sam_eng: After initial eval, we can propose a Canary rollout plan: 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% with automated rollback on quality regressions and latency breach. I’ll draft the route and autoscale knobs.
maria_cs: Noted. I'll add potential renewal impact to the account health doc and flag for AM. If we see growth beyond committed, we schedule a renewal upsell discussion — good to align now.
caleb_elmshore: Perfect. I'll upload the artifact access and the eval set by Tue EOD and confirm calendar invite. Thanks team.
